name: B10-0290/2025 (PPE) – Media freedom in Georgia, particularly the case of Mzia Amaglobeli
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on media freedom in Georgia, particularly the case of Mzia Amaglobeli
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and making demands. It condemns Georgia's government for cracking down on independent media and civil society. It calls for the release of journalist Mzia Amaglobeli, held since January 2025 and facing four to seven years in prison, and of other jailed activists. It also asks European Union member states to impose sanctions on Georgian officials responsible for these arrests.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. This is an opinion and a set of demands, not a law.
- **Who it affects:** Georgia's government, jailed journalist Mzia Amaglobeli and other detained activists.
- **What happens next:** The text goes to European Union institutions and member states, which may decide on sanctions.
